name: pebble
description: Energy mobile employee (RN/Expo/EAS). Takes a product idea to a shipped, store-safe, OTA-maintainable iOS + Android app: picks the shape (native/PWA/bare), scaffolds a New-Architecture-correct Expo app, builds & ships via EAS headlessly, maintains it via OTA within the wall, and survives App-Store review. A tool-employee consumed by coding agents and a local cockpit (no reachability face) — this card describes its CLI/MCP capabilities; pebble is not a hosted HTTP A2A endpoint. Powered by Energy.

skills.name: Decide the mobile shape
skills.description: Decide PWA vs native (and the native shape) for a product — especially an AI/agent app — via the '3+ → native' rule and the iOS PWA capability walls. Exposed as `pebble decide` and the `pebble_decide_shape` MCP tool.
examples: PWA or native for an app that needs BLE + background location + push?
Should this agent app ship to the App Store at all?

skills.name: Scaffold a New-Arch Expo app
skills.description: Scaffold a correct, modern, New-Architecture-only Expo app with the SDK pinned explicitly, native deps installed the right way, and the expo-doctor gate. Exposed as `pebble init` and the `pebble_init` MCP tool.
examples: Scaffold a React Native app on SDK 56.
Start a new Expo project for the Energy pnpm monorepo.

skills.name: Build headlessly via EAS
skills.description: Run an EAS Build headlessly (--non-interactive --no-wait --json injected) and return a build id. Exposed as `pebble build` and the `pebble_eas_build` MCP tool.
examples: Build the iOS app on the preview profile.
Kick off an Android EAS build and give me the build id.

skills.name: Submit to the stores via EAS
skills.description: Submit a built app to the App Store / Play headlessly (ASC API key / Play service-account), warning on the documented manual-first-Play-upload wall. Exposed as `pebble submit` and the `pebble_eas_submit` MCP tool.
examples: Submit the latest iOS build to App Store Connect.
Submit to Play — flag any first-upload walls.

skills.name: Ship an OTA update within the wall
skills.description: Ship a JS/asset-only OTA via `eas update` (--environment ENFORCED), rejecting any native-touching diff (the 'Native module cannot be null' wall = Apple Guideline 2.5.2). Exposed as `pebble update` and the `pebble_eas_update` MCP tool.
examples: Is this change safe to ship as an OTA?
Push a JS update to the production channel.

skills.name: Pre-flight App-Store review
skills.description: Pre-flight an app (especially an AI/agent app) against App Store rejection BEFORE submit — the 2.5.2 self-modifying-code wall, 4.3 thin-wrapper/differentiation, the 5.1.2(i) consent modal, age rating, and the 1.2 UGC-removal duty. Exposed as `pebble review-check` and the `pebble_review_check` MCP tool.
examples: Will Apple reject this AI app?
Pre-flight the store-review risks before I submit.

skills.name: Verify as a USER (simulator screenshot)
skills.description: The verify-as-USER QA primitive — boot the app in the iOS simulator / Android emulator and capture a screenshot to READ ('it builds' means nothing). Exposed as `pebble screenshot` and the `pebble_screenshot` MCP tool.
examples: Boot the scaffold in the iOS simulator and screenshot it.
Capture an Android emulator screenshot of the home screen.
